title: Model conditional layered OBJ source pairs
changes: Add a strict source-authenticated model for sixteen conditional layered OBJ/sequence pairs, retaining opaque descriptor bytes and original bank structures.
validation: The corrected complete Wine filter verifies all 633 source spans/20,474 bytes, JSON roundtrip, six malformed cases, coherent-edit/source rejection and all 16 original 08142590 initializer cases with EWRAM guards. Evidence: target/validation/units/e130-layered-obj-guard-build-kgdzhcvt/ and e130-layered-obj-model-wine-guards-3b5b_3e5/. Protected inputs passed and successful scratch was removed.

The retained first build badn5dd7 lacked a Bus trait import; Wine attempts n8dw99_c and p47ajr46 exposed test-only r12 preservation and empty-list assumptions. Corrected test passes in the final full filter.
limitations: The model is not attached to extraction or runtime; native reads, lifecycle, CLI, the complete draw routine and ordinary use remain open. Linux, USA and native Windows are not established.
The primary model and reasoning effort could not be independently confirmed during the source-supported test corrections; no consultation was needed. No performance measurement.
